Sword & Shield series · CEL

Celebrations

Released October 8, 2021 · 25 cards

Expanded

Celebrations is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on October 8, 2021. It has 25 cards. It includes 23 Pokémon, 2 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

12 illustrators worked on Celebrations. Most cards: aky CG Works (4), kirisAki (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (3), 5ban Graphics (2), AKIRA EGAWA (2), Aya Kusube (2), Kouki Saitou (2), Ryuta Fuse (2).
